Same allocator identity required; reject self, active child stack/reservation, child taskgraphs or enabled child exact-work capture.

Parent active stage selects attachment; parent task reservations, taskgraphs, capture flags and exact-work counters remain untouched.
tests: Concurrent private child writers with both scopes active simultaneously; stable coordinator-defined sibling order after join.
Active child stages/reservations, wrong allocator, self, child taskgraphs and exact-work rejection without ownership moves.
Parent active task reservation and enabled exact-work capture unchanged.
Exhaustive allocation failures and emptied-child reuse leave every owner reclaimable.
scope: General stage-only adoption seam only. App-private component binding/restoration, after-prover adoption and proof/error cleanup are qualified separately by root/byteagent.
allocator_identity: Both adoptJoined and adoptJoinedStages now use one private concrete-std identity helper. Recognized stateless allocators are identified by vtable without reading their undefined context; stateful allocator contexts still must match. No frontend dependency.
documentation: Recorder explicitly documents one serial owner, no thread safety, private recorder per concurrent callback, and coordinator-only adoption after all writers join.
